headline: The real iPhone app explains the account boundary before asking for data
overview: A live walk of the installed Scribe Quest iOS app through sign-in and account creation without submitting credentials or creating an account.

steps.title: Conversation history is explicitly account-scoped
steps.action: Launched the real Scribe Quest iPhone app and dismissed the simulator's Apple-account prompt.
steps.description: The native sign-in screen offers Google, Apple, and email, says why authentication is required, and delays microphone permission until capture begins.
steps.screenshotAlt: Scribe Quest native sign-in screen on iPhone

steps.title: Account creation is visible without being executed
steps.action: Opened Create an account and stopped before entering or submitting information.
steps.description: The native surface states that no credit card is required and shows the cross-device account options. No account or personal data was created.
steps.screenshotAlt: Scribe Quest native create account screen on iPhone

keyFeatures: Native Google, Apple, and email sign-in
note: Captured from the actual com.humanquest.scribe iPhone simulator build, version 1.0.5+43, on iOS 26.5. The binary predates the current source HEAD, so no source SHA is claimed.
